name: canva-depth-archive-tooling
description: Canva Design Editor application/tooling with independent HoloForge and DepthPop apps, authenticated archive verification, maintained runtime adapters, and trusted Design Editor integration.

scripts.check: npm run verify:release && npm run verify:syntax && npm test
scripts.app:verify: npm run app:verify:holoforge && npm run app:verify:depthpop
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix apps/holoforge-canva run format:check && npm --prefix apps/depthpop-canva run format:check
scripts.app:verify:holoforge: npm --prefix apps/holoforge-canva ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix apps/holoforge-canva audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix apps/holoforge-canva run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/holoforge-canva run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/holoforge-canva run build
scripts.app:verify:depthpop: npm --prefix apps/depthpop-canva ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix apps/depthpop-canva audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix apps/depthpop-canva run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/depthpop-canva run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/depthpop-canva run build
